discipline: Refute, do not confirm. This turn is a leftover remasurement of g09 leftover-join.v11 after permission leftover-join.v12 (D-283) and doctor-actor leftover-join.v12 (D-285), not a SATISFIED-GRADE cycle, so the governing question is whether leftover-join.v12 changed any measurement while claiming only to retarget two ROW citations and to add landing-version custody to nine dispositions. That was tested structurally first: leftover-join.v11 and leftover-join.v12 were flattened to leaf paths and every removal, every shared-key value change and every addition was classified against the change list the review prompt asserts. All 58 unique path/sha256 pairs and all 60 recordedInputs entries were recomputed from live bytes. All six recording commits were resolved in git and checked for ancestry of HEAD. Every derived claim about a parent artifact (occupancy v4, occupancy v3, permission leftover-join.v12, permission leftover-join.v9, permission leftover-join.v6, permission leftover-join.v7, doctor-actor leftover-join.v12, doctor-actor leftover-join.v11, the catalog, the R-6/R-10 corpus, the D-056 draft, and every cited review file) was re-derived from that artifact's own bytes rather than carried from the subject's summary of it. Every findingDisposition landing version was checked against the findingDisposition arrays of leftover-join.v4 through leftover-join.v11. Every whitespace-preceded version token in the subject was enumerated with its preceding word. Every attack in the review prompt was run as an attempt to break the artifact, plus four of this reviewer's own. Four candidate defects were examined; all four failed the test that a finding must be false in these bytes, not merely improvable, and are recorded in observationsNotFindings so the reasoning is auditable rather than silent.
decisionRule: ACCEPT only at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Zero blockers, zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX stand, so the verdict is ACCEPT.

Precise disclosure: that filename became incidentally visible in the git status listing run at the very end of this review, after this file had been written and frozen, to confirm that nothing beyond this review file had been modified. That is an observation of a path, not of a verdict; the file was not opened. This verdict is Claude 2's alone and an ACCEPT here does not predict or depend on the Codex outcome. Distinct from that: the frozen Codex reviews of predecessor and parent artifacts pinned in the subject's own basedOn and recordedInputs were digest-verified and their verdict fields were read, because the subject asserts specific Codex standings for them (ACCEPT 0/0 on leftover-join.v6 through leftover-join.v11 of this lineage, on permission leftover-join.v9 and v12, on doctor-actor leftover-join.v11 and v12, and on occupancy v4; REJECT 0/1 PLJ-V7-SF1 on permission leftover-join.v7; REJECT 0/1 G09-V4-SF1 on leftover-join.v4; REJECT 1 blocker G09LJ-V5-B1 on leftover-join.v5; REJECT 0/1 G09LJ-V9-SF1 on leftover-join.v9) and misstating a reviewer standing is the defect class that produced G09LJ-V4-B2 and G09LJ-V5-B1. Those are frozen predecessor inputs, not this turn's counterpart.
reviewerDisclosure: This reviewer role authored G09LJ-V4-B1, G09LJ-V4-B2, G09LJ-V5-B1, G09LJ-V5-SF1, G09LJ-V6-SF1, G09LJ-V7-SF1, G09LJ-V8-SF1 and G09LJ-V9-SF1 across the frozen predecessor reviews of this lineage, issued the ACCEPT 0/0 at leftover-join.v10 and at leftover-join.v11, and issued the Stage A ACCEPT 0/0 on permission leftover-join.v12 and doctor-actor leftover-join.v12, which this subject now cites as current. Two biases are live and were guarded in opposite directions. First, having accepted the predecessor and both newly-cited ROW joins, a reviewer is biased toward accepting a successor that merely re-cites them; this was met by running the flatten-diff and the byte re-derivations as the primary instruments so that any silent change would surface mechanically. Second, a reviewer who accepted the predecessor can overcorrect and manufacture a finding to demonstrate continued independence; this was met by requiring that any candidate defect be false in these bytes under a reading the document's own conventions support. Four candidates were examined and all four failed that test. This reviewer did not author the subject or any artifact cited by it.

observationsNotFindings.observation: authorityClaim opens its second sentence with the subject's own bare label: 'v12 remasures leftover-join.v11 after permission leftover-join.v12 (D-283) and doctor-actor leftover-join.v12 (D-285).' Unlike permission leftover-join.v12, where the same construction was examined and no competing v12 was cited anywhere in that subject, here two competing-lineage v12 artifacts are cited in the very sentence, and doctor-actor leftover-join.v12 also remasures a leftover-join.v11 of its own lineage.
observationsNotFindings.whyNotAFinding: The token is not false and is not ambiguous under the conventions the document itself establishes and applies without exception: every cross-lineage citation in the subject is family-qualified at the point of use ('permission leftover-join.v12', 'doctor-actor leftover-join.v12'), and every bare 'leftover-join.vN' in the subject denotes this lineage, so 'v12 remasures leftover-join.v11' can only be read as the speaker, which the prompt itself labels 'this v12 (g09 leftover-join.v12)'. The construction is the recorded corpus convention, not an accident of this fold: g09 leftover-join.v11 (D-257), g18 leftover-join.v6 (D-276), g16 leftover-join.v5 (D-278), g08 leftover-join.v5 (D-281), permission leftover-join.v12 (D-283) and doctor-actor leftover-join.v12 (D-285) all open authorityClaim's second sentence the same way, and doctor-actor leftover-join.v12 does so while pinning permission leftover-join.v12 ten times in the same file; each was dual ACCEPT 0/0 and recorded. Both reviewers' findings that this lineage and the permission and component-manifest lineages have actually broken on (G09LJ-V7-SF1, G09LJ-V9-SF1, PLJ-V10-SF1, CMLJ-V7-SF1) concerned a bare token that named a different artifact than the reader would resolve it to, or a self-description that had become false; neither is the case here. A SHOULD-FIX would therefore charge a stylistic preference against a sentence that is true in these bytes and would contradict the standard this reviewer applied to permission leftover-join.v12 and doctor-actor leftover-join.v12 four days ago. If a later fold of this lineage is opened for any other reason, 'This v12 remasures ...' or 'leftover-join.v12 of this lineage remasures ...' would remove the last inference step; it is not owed here.

decision.rationale: leftover-join.v12 is a faithful leftover remasurement. Its premise was verified rather than assumed: leftover-join.v11 does cite permission leftover-join.v9 and doctor-actor leftover-join.v11 as current, and D-283 and D-285 have since recorded their v12 successors, so a remasurement is warranted; and D-257 is confirmed as the latest G09 leftover-join recording, so v11 is genuinely current at draft time as the subject and prompt both say. What v12 changed is exactly what a remasurement should change and nothing else, established by field-level diff rather than prose: three keys removed (the d256 custody pin, per the g18/g16/g08 precedent), fifty-five added (four decision pins, three provenance objects, nine recordedInputs entries, four disclaimers), thirty-one values changed (identity, pins, the two ROW retargets carried as history, and nine landing-version clauses), zero obligation measurements changed, summary.leftoverDesign still exactly [OBL-FX-AUTHORING]. Every citation resolves: 58 unique digests plus 60 recordedInputs recomputed with zero mismatches, six commits confirmed with matching subject lines and HEAD ancestry, basedOn.d285 pinning the recording commit rather than the hygiene commit. Every derived claim about a parent was re-derived from that parent's bytes: the fourteen FX classes and the eight-member DR-105 list match occupancy v4 and v3; permission leftover-join.v12 and doctor-actor leftover-join.v12 carry the leftoverDesign sets and the dual ACCEPT 0/0 standings the subject states, list-identical to v9 and v11 respectively; all nine findingDisposition landing versions match the first version of this lineage whose findingDisposition carries the identifier, including the G09LJ-V4-B2 dual landing. The constructions this lineage has broken on before are all held: no 'This v11' survives, every cross-lineage token is family-qualified, every loss-of-currency sentence carries the successor-recorded qualifier, predecessorV11.recording is D-257, basedOn.d287.role is last-heading custody only, parentReview names naming v6 (D-145) as naming parent, no lands array exists, and permission leftover-join.v6 and v7 are never called current or recorded. All twenty-eight prompt attacks plus four of this reviewer's own were run and all thirty-two were refuted. Four candidate defects were examined seriously and all four proved true-in-these-bytes and convention-consistent rather than false. Zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX stand.
